current_row.boundary_rationale: Onset: a messenger formula with an addressee change opens a fresh sub-unit at Ezek.34.17 וְאַתֵּ֣נָה צֹאנִ֔י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁפֵט֙ בֵּֽין שֶׂ֣ה לָשֶׂ֔ה לָאֵילִ֖ים וְלָעַתּוּדִֽים (oshb:Ezek.34.17), turning to address 'my flock' directly (second-feminine-plural, distinct from the third-person shepherds just indicted) — the addressee-change licence for a messenger-formula cut. A second messenger formula follows at Ezek.34.20 לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הִנְנִי אָ֕נִי וְשָֽׁפַטְתִּי֙ בֵּֽין שֶׂ֣ה בִרְיָ֔ה וּבֵ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה רָזָֽה (oshb:Ezek.34.20), after a samekh mark following Ezek.34.19 וְצֹאנִ֑י מִרְמַ֤ס רַגְלֵיכֶם֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה וּמִרְפַּ֥שׂ רַגְלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּשְׁתֶּֽינָה (oshb:Ezek.34.19); disclosed as paragraph-internal, not row-final, since the judgment between fat and lean sheep opens directly into the 'one shepherd' promise. The emphatic close “I, Yahweh, have spoken” follows at Ezek.34.24 וַאֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְעַבְדִּ֥י דָוִ֖ד נָשִׂ֣יא בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי (oshb:Ezek.34.24), disclosed as an internal emphatic close, not final, since the covenant-of-peace material continues through Ezek.34.25-Ezek.34.30. A recognition formula closes that material at Ezek.34.27 וְנָתַן֩ עֵ֨ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה אֶת פִּרְי֗וֹ וְהָאָ֨רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְהָי֥וּ עַל אַדְמָתָ֖ם לָבֶ֑טַח וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בְּשִׁבְרִי֙ אֶת מֹט֣וֹת עֻלָּ֔ם וְהִ֨צַּלְתִּ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד הָעֹבְדִ֥ים בָּהֶֽם (oshb:Ezek.34.27) and again at Ezek.34.30 וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּ֑ם וְהֵ֗מָּה עַמִּי֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה (oshb:Ezek.34.30), both disclosed as paragraph-final rather than row-final, since Ezek.34.31 restates the covenant formula once more. Close: the utterance formula at Ezek.34.31 וְאַתֵּ֥ן צֹאנִ֛י צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י אָדָ֣ם אַתֶּ֑ם אֲנִי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה (oshb:Ezek.34.31) plus a pe mark close this row, immediately before the fresh word-event of Ezek.35.1.

A second internal close falls at Ezek.35.9 שִֽׁמְמ֤וֹת עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּנְךָ֔ וְעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תישבנה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה (oshb:Ezek.35.9), a 2mp recognition-family clause, immediately followed by a second causal “because” paragraph at Ezek.35.10 יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מָרְךָ אֶת שְׁנֵ֨י הַגּוֹיִ֜ם וְאֶת שְׁתֵּ֧י הָאֲרָצ֛וֹת לִ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ינָה וִֽירַשְׁנ֑וּהָ וַֽיהוָ֖ה שָׁ֥ם הָיָֽה (oshb:Ezek.35.10), citing the nations’ claim on Israel’s and Judah’s territory. oshb:Ezek.35.9 also carries a ketiv/qere note: ketiv ‘תישבנה’, Qere ‘תָשֹׁ֑בְנָה’ (“will not be inhabited”), split from the K/Q note layer with its separators stripped. Ezek.35.12 וְֽיָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּֽי אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי אֶת כָּל נָאָֽצוֹתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֣ר שממה לָ֥נוּ נִתְּנ֖וּ לְאָכְלָֽה (oshb:Ezek.35.12) opens with a further 2ms recognition-formula clause (“then you will know that I am Yahweh”), but this one stands verse-initial rather than verse-final and is not itself paragraph-final: the same verse continues directly into “I have heard,” and the verdict runs on through Ezek.35.13-Ezek.35.14 with no fresh onset device intervening — this recognition clause is disclosed as internal texture, not as a third closed sub-unit. oshb:Ezek.35.12 also carries a ketiv/qere note: ketiv ‘שממה’, Qere ‘שָׁמֵ֑מוּ’ (“they have been laid desolate”), split from the K/Q note layer with its separators stripped. Close: the 3mp recognition formula at Ezek.35.15 כְּשִׂמְחָ֨תְךָ֜ לְנַחְלַ֧ת בֵּֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה לָּ֑ךְ שְׁמָמָ֨ה תִֽהְיֶ֤ה הַר שֵׂעִיר֙ וְכָל אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה (oshb:Ezek.35.15) plus a pe mark close the row and the chapter, immediately before the 'and you, son of man' sub-onset opens the mountains-of-Israel side of the diptych at Ezek.36.1.
